oneLine: ITC acquires 100% ownership of Sproutlife Foods, maker of Yoga Bar.

sources.title: ITC acquires 100% of Sproutlife Foods, maker of Yoga Bar products

synopsis: Diversified conglomerate ITC Ltd acquired the remaining 52.5 per cent stake in Sproutlife Foods, the maker of Yoga Bar products, for approximately ₹645 crore. The transaction was conducted through a secondary purchase of 13,445 equity shares, giving ITC 100 per cent ownership and making Sproutlife a wholly owned subsidiary. Prior to this acquisition, ITC held a 47.5 per cent stake on a fully diluted basis with a cumulative investment of ₹255 crore. The move aligns with ITC's strategy to strengthen its future-ready foods portfolio as Yoga Bar maintains momentum across Bars, Muesli, Oats, and protein products.
